verdict.rationale: Paperspace has no documented sandbox or test mode. A user can approximate one by provisioning separate, disposable machines through the console, API or CLI, cloning configurations via custom templates, and choosing whether to attach a private network. That isolates experiments from other workloads, but only as a workaround. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging environment or test API mode, documented separation from production data (e.g. separate projects/teams or scoped keys), and independent or hands-on corroboration of isolated testing workflows.
